title: 第9章 沉淀第10章 今年十八岁刚出新手村
slug: 我在西幻世界独断万古
content_zh:
那天的对话之后，艾琳娜没有立刻给季天答复。
她只是说了句“我考虑考虑”，然后就像什么都没发生过一样，该干嘛干嘛。
第二天一早，季天照例去她房间报到——端早餐、整理书架、陪她读书。
艾琳娜坐在窗边，手里捏着那本翻了一个月都没翻完的小说，目光时不时从书页上方飘出来，落在季天身上。
季天站在书架前，把昨天翻乱的几本书重新归位。
艾琳娜突然开口道：“第七排第三本，你放错位置了，那是魔法理论，不是历史。”
季天低头看了一眼手里的书，封面确实写着《大陆通史》，“这本是历史。”
“我说的是你刚才放的那本。”
“我刚才没放魔法理论。”
“你放了。”
“我没——”
季天转过头，看见艾琳娜正盯着他，嘴角微翘，一副“我抓到你把柄了”的表情。
他沉默了一秒。
“……你在诈我。”
“嗯。”艾琳娜大方地承认了，把书往膝盖上一合，“所以你刚才确实在走神，在想什么？”
季天没说话。
艾琳娜也不催，就那样看着他，灰蓝色的眼睛里带着一种“你不说我也知道”的笃定。
过了几秒，季天开口了：“在想怎么修炼。”
“在我这儿？”
“嗯。”

“当着我的面？”
“对。”
艾琳娜深吸一口气，又缓缓吐出来。她把书放在旁边的矮桌上，站起来，走到季天面前。
她比他矮半个头，但仰着下巴看人的时候，气势一点都不矮。
“季天，”她望着他，一字一句道，“你知道你现在的处境吗？”
“知道。”
“你是我的侍从。你的任务是陪我解闷，不是在我眼皮底下修炼。”
“我可以同时做这两件事。”
艾琳娜闻言挑了挑眉，“怎么同时做？你一边陪我说话，一边冥想？”
“可以。”
“你一边给我端茶，一边运转魔力？”
“可以。”
“你一边——”艾琳娜顿了顿，似乎觉得这个对话的方向不太对，“等等，我不是在给你出主意。我的意思是，你不能在我这里修炼。”
“为什么？”
“因为——”她话音一滞，又连忙补上，“因为你是我的侍从……你首要任务是陪我，不是修炼。”
“我陪你的时候，脑子空着也是空着，”季天说，“不如用来运转周天。”
艾琳娜盯着他看了三秒。
“周天是什么？”
“魔力循环的一种方式，你们叫‘回路运转’，我叫‘周天’。”
content_en:
After the conversation that day, Elena did not immediately reply to Ji Tian.
She just said "I'll think about it" and then acted like nothing happened and did whatever she had to do.
Early the next morning, Ji Tian reported to her room as usual - serving breakfast, organizing bookshelves, and reading with her.
Elena sat by the window, holding the novel in her hand that she had not finished reading for a month. Her eyes drifted from the top of the page from time to time and fell on Ji Tian.
Ji Tian stood in front of the bookshelf and put back the books he had messed up yesterday.
Elena suddenly said: "The third book in the seventh row, you put it in the wrong place. That is magic theory, not history."
Ji Tian lowered his head and glanced at the book in his hand. The cover indeed said "General History of the Mainland", "This book is history."
"I'm talking about the one you just placed."
"I didn't mention the magic theory just now."
"You let it go."
"I didn't—"
Ji Tian turned his head and saw Elena staring at him, the corners of her mouth slightly raised, with an expression of "I've caught you".
He was silent for a second.
"...You are deceiving me."
"Yeah." Elena admitted generously and closed the book on her knees, "So you were really distracted just now. What were you thinking about?"
Ji Tian said nothing.
Elena didn't rush him, she just looked at him like that, with a kind of certainty in her gray-blue eyes that "I know even if you don't tell me."
After a few seconds, Ji Tian spoke: "I'm thinking about how to practice."
"At my place?"
"Yeah."
"In front of me?"
"Yes."
Elena took a deep breath and let it out slowly. She put the book on the low table next to her, stood up, and walked to Ji Tian.
She was half a head shorter than him, but when she looked at people with her chin raised, her aura was not short at all.
"Ji Tian," she looked at him and said word by word, "do you know your current situation?"
"I know."
"You are my attendant. Your job is to accompany me to relieve my boredom, not to practice under my nose."
“I can do both at the same time.”
Elena raised her eyebrows when she heard this, "How to do it at the same time? You talk to me and meditate at the same time?"
"Okay."
"You're serving me tea and running your magic at the same time?"
"Okay."
"On your side -" Elena paused, as if she felt that the direction of this conversation was not right, "Wait, I'm not giving you advice. I mean, you can't practice here."
"Why?"
"Because -" she paused, then quickly added, "because you are my attendant... your first priority is to accompany me, not to practice."
"When I'm with you, my mind is empty," Ji Tian said. "It's better to use it to move the sky."
Elena stared at him for three seconds.
"What is Zhou Tian?"
"A way of magic circulation, you call it 'loop operation', I call it 'Zhou Tian'."
